title: Post-Impressionism
description: Bold color and expressive form — the bridge from Impressionism to modern art.
source: Art Institute of Chicago, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: A bearded man with reddish hair gazes intently outward, rendered in short dotted strokes of blue, green, and orange. This is one of Van Gogh's self-portraits, painted in oil in 1887 and now in the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: self-portrait, portrait, van gogh, pointillist strokes, post-impressionism, oil painting

items.title: The Poet's Garden
items.description_narrative: A lush, overgrown garden glows under a sickly yellow-green evening sky, a weeping willow trailing at right and a dark conifer at left. A glimpse of blue rooftop is the only sign of a building beyond the tangle of trees and flowering shrubs.
items.tags: garden, park, trees, evening light, landscape, oil painting

items.title: A Peasant Woman Digging in Front of Her Cottage
items.description_narrative: A woman bends over her spade in the dirt before a thatched cottage, its steep roof rendered in heavy, dry strokes of brown and gray. A thin curl of smoke rises from the chimney, the only sign of warmth in an otherwise bare, overcast scene.
items.tags: peasant, digging, cottage, rural labor, oil painting, muted palette

items.title: The Drinkers
items.description_narrative: Four figures in blue and green raise glasses and a jug at a café table beneath a swirling grey sky, a child peeking over the tabletop's edge. Van Gogh painted this in February 1890; it's now at the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: drinkers, café scene, figures, van gogh, art institute of chicago

items.title: Fishing in Spring, the Pont de Clichy (Asnières)
items.description_narrative: A man sits fishing in a small green boat moored beside an empty one, slender trees leaning over the water and a bridge arching across the river beyond. Van Gogh painted this in 1887; it's held by the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: river, boats, bridge, spring landscape, van gogh, art institute of chicago

items.title: Madame Roulin Rocking the Cradle (La berceuse)
items.description_narrative: A length of rope rests in her folded hands, the cord for rocking a cradle just out of view. Behind her, a dense tangle of stylized flowers covers the wall like wallpaper. The sitter is identified as Augustine Roulin.
items.tags: portrait, woman, floral pattern, folded hands, green dress, oil painting, post-impressionism

items.title: Terrace and Observation Deck at the Moulin de Blute-Fin, Montmartre
items.medium: Oil on canvas, mounted on pressboard
items.description_narrative: A row of gaslamps lines a railed walkway leading toward a raised wooden platform where two figures in dark coats look out over the city. Below, two more figures pause near the platform's stairs, small against the pale, hazy sky.
items.tags: terrace, lamps, figures, montmartre, oil painting

items.title: Grapes, Lemons, Pears, and Apples
items.description_narrative: Dark grapes spill across a table beside lemons, apples, and a green pear, painted in short, swirling strokes that make the tablecloth ripple like water. The still life is dated 1887 and held by the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: still life, grapes, lemons, apples, art institute of chicago

items.title: Weeping Tree
items.medium: Reed pen and black-brown ink, with black chalk on off-white wove paper
items.description_narrative: Dense, looping pen strokes build a heavily foliaged tree at the center of a walled garden, its bark and branches barely distinguishable from the tangle of leaves above. Tall grass and small flowers are rendered in short vertical dashes across the foreground, with a bird perched on the low wall at right. Van Gogh drew this view of a park at Arles; it is now in the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: pen and ink drawing, tree, garden, foliage, park, sketch, monochrome

items.title: The Basket of Apples
items.description_narrative: A basket of apples tips forward beside scattered fruit, a dark wine bottle, and a plate of biscuits, all set on a rumpled white cloth. Paul Cézanne painted this still life in oil on canvas around 1893; it belongs to the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: still life, apples, fruit, cezanne, post-impressionism, oil painting

items.title: The Bay of Marseille, Seen from L'Estaque
items.description_narrative: Terracotta rooftops step down to a deep blue bay, distant mountains rising along the far shore in soft violet-grey. Cézanne painted this view around 1885; the Art Institute of Chicago now owns it.
items.tags: landscape, bay, coastline, rooftops, provence, art institute of chicago
items.credit_line: 1QFFkcktbe4rAg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Auvers, Panoramic View
items.description_narrative: A hillside village of white houses and red-tiled roofs spreads out below, seen from an elevated vantage point over a wide, hazy valley. Loosely dabbed greens and browns give the rooftops and gardens a soft, textured unity.
items.tags: auvers, panoramic view, village, elevated viewpoint

items.title: Madame Cezanne in a Yellow Chair
items.description_narrative: A seated woman in a deep red dress rests her clasped hands in her lap, the patterned yellow chair behind her nearly swallowing her dark hair. Cézanne painted this portrait between 1888 and 1890; it's held by the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: portrait, yellow chair, red dress, cézanne, art institute of chicago

items.title: The Vase of Tulips
items.description_narrative: Red tulips arch out of a green-glazed vase, mixed with white narcissus and small yellow blossoms, their stems and leaves splaying wide across a pale blue-grey wall. Two peach-colored fruit rest on the table in front of the vase, with another pale fruit tucked behind it. Cézanne painted this still life around 1890; it belongs to the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: still life, tulips, flowers, vase, fruit, table, oil painting

items.title: The Bathers
items.description_narrative: Nude bathers cluster in two loose groups on a riverbank beneath arching trees, their forms built from simplified blue-green brushstrokes. Paul Cézanne painted this in oil on canvas around 1900; it belongs to the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: bathers, nude figures, landscape, cezanne, post-impressionism, proto-cubism

items.title: The Plate of Apples
items.description_narrative: A white bowl brims with apples in red, green, and gold, set against wallpaper patterned with small blue crosses. The same cool blue reappears in the cloth beneath, tying the arrangement together.
items.tags: still life, apples, bowl, patterned wallpaper, oil painting

items.title: Bathers
items.description_narrative: Five bathers cluster in a wooded clearing, a slender church spire rising faintly beyond the trees, painted in the same blocky, faceted brushwork Cézanne used throughout his bather scenes.
items.tags: bathers, group figures, church spire, wooded landscape, faceted brushwork

items.title: Standing Bather, Seen from the Back
items.description_narrative: A nude man stands with his back to us, drying himself with a white cloth held in one raised hand. Loose greens and blues stand in for the surrounding foliage, the figure rendered with the same broad, unblended strokes as the landscape around him.
items.tags: bather, nude figure, back view, landscape, oil painting

items.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
items.description_narrative: Built from countless small dots of pure color, a park scene unfolds along a riverbank crowded with strollers, parasols, a monkey on a leash, and a small dog trotting through the grass. Figures near the viewer are rendered with almost sculptural stillness, while sailboats drift on the water beyond.
items.tags: park, pointillism, figures, riverbank, oil painting

items.title: Oil Sketch for "A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884"
items.description_narrative: Loose dabs of unblended color suggest strolling figures on a riverside lawn rather than describe them in detail, a man in a top hat at right, women in bustled dresses at center. This small panel is a quick, atmospheric study rather than a finished scene.
items.tags: sketch, park, figures, preparatory study, oil painting

items.title: Final Study for "Bathers at Asnières"
items.description_narrative: Figures rest and bathe along a riverbank in soft, mottled color, with a seated man in a hat gazing across the water toward smoking factory chimneys on the far shore. Georges Seurat painted this study in oil on panel in 1883, now in the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: bathers, seurat, post-impressionism, riverbank, oil painting, study, figures, chicago

items.title: The Starry Night
items.description_narrative: A cypress tree rises like dark flame in the foreground, framed by a sky of swirling blue clouds, bright stars, and a glowing crescent moon. A quiet village of small houses and a church spire sits beneath the turbulent sky, the only calm note in the composition.
items.tags: night sky, cypress, village, swirling clouds, oil painting

items.title: Sunflowers
items.description_narrative: Fifteen sunflowers in every stage from full bloom to dried seed head crowd a plain ceramic vase, all set against a wall of matching yellow. Thick ridges of paint build up each flower's shaggy petals and dark seed centers in high relief.
items.tags: sunflowers, vase, yellow palette, still life, oil painting

items.title: Café Terrace at Night
items.description_narrative: A yellow-awninged café glows warm against a deep blue, star-flecked sky, diners seated at round tables spilling onto the cobblestone street. Van Gogh painted this in September 1888; the Kröller-Müller Museum now holds it.
items.tags: café, night scene, starry sky, arles, van gogh, kröller-müller museum

items.title: Starry Night Over the Rhône
items.description_narrative: Gas lamps along the riverbank throw long, rippling streaks of gold across the dark water, echoed by a scatter of stars overhead. A couple walks arm in arm in the foreground, small against the wide expanse of river and sky.
items.tags: night sky, river, reflection, gas lamps, oil painting

items.title: Irises
items.description_narrative: Deep violet irises crowd a bed of green, spiky leaves, a single white iris standing out among them near marigolds at the edge. Van Gogh painted this in 1889; it's held by the J. Paul Getty Museum.
items.tags: irises, flowers, garden, van gogh, getty museum
items.credit_line: DgFVFAJo_30MeQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Wheatfield with Crows
items.description_narrative: A jagged blue sky, streaked with heavy brushstrokes, presses down over a bright yellow wheat field, where a scattering of black birds wheels upward in a loose arc. Three dirt paths converge and split in the foreground, cutting green and rust-colored tracks through the grain. Van Gogh painted this in July 1890; it belongs to the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: wheat field, crows, stormy sky, path, landscape, oil painting, turbulent sky

items.title: Montagne Sainte-Victoire with Large Pine
items.description_narrative: A gnarled pine bough arches across the sky, framing a patchwork of fields and rooftops that stretch toward a pale mountain in the distance. Paul Cézanne painted this view of Montagne Sainte-Victoire around 1887.
items.tags: cezanne, mont sainte-victoire, provence, landscape, post-impressionism, pine tree

items.title: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?
items.description_narrative: A long frieze of figures moves across a shadowy tropical landscape, from a crouching infant and sleeping woman at one end to a hunched, white-haired figure at the other. At center, a young man reaches up to pick fruit, while a pale blue idol looms behind two robed women nearby. A white bird, a black dog, and goats punctuate the scene, and gold lettering fills the upper corners. Gauguin painted this frieze between 1897 and 1898.
items.tags: tahiti, figures, symbolism, allegory, idol, frieze, oil painting

items.title: Vision After the Sermon (Jacob Wrestling with the Angel)
items.description_narrative: Women in tall white Breton coiffes fill the foreground, eyes lowered in prayer, while behind them a diagonal brown branch splits a flat, vermilion ground in two. In the upper right corner a winged figure grapples with a man; a small cow grazes nearby at the upper left. Gauguin painted this scene of Breton folk costume in 1888, in the style of the Pont-Aven School; it belongs to National Galleries Scotland.
items.tags: breton costume, prayer, vision, symbolism, pont-aven, religious scene, oil painting

items.title: The Potato Eaters
items.description_narrative: Five figures gather around a small table lit by a single hanging lamp, sharing a plate of potatoes and pouring coffee in the dim light. Their faces are built from heavy, earth-toned strokes, the same dull greens and browns as the shadowed room around them.
items.tags: peasants, dinner table, lamplight, dark palette, oil painting
items.credit_line: rQE6qmf9oVuKPA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Wheatfield with Cypresses
items.description_narrative: Golden wheat fields stretch beneath a swirling, cloud-filled sky, with a dark cypress tree rising beside olive-green shrubs and distant blue mountains. Vincent van Gogh painted this scene in oil on canvas in 1889. It is held in the National Gallery.
items.tags: van gogh, post-impressionism, landscape, cypress, wheatfield, oil painting, clouds, provence

items.title: The Yellow Christ
items.description_narrative: A bright yellow figure of Christ hangs on the cross at the center, set against an autumn landscape of rust-red trees and a distant village. Two women in white coifs and dark aprons kneel at the foot of the cross, while a third figure's bowed head appears at the lower right. Gauguin based this painting on a wooden crucifix at the Chapelle de Trémalo and painted it in 1889; it belongs to the Buffalo AKG Art Museum.
items.tags: crucifixion, yellow christ, kneeling figures, symbolism, religious scene, oil painting

items.title: Equestrienne (At the Cirque Fernando)
items.description_narrative: A ringmaster cracks his whip as a bareback rider in a green tutu balances on a cantering white horse, the circus benches crowded with spectators behind them. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this scene around 1887-88; it hangs at the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: circus, equestrienne, ringmaster, montmartre, toulouse-lautrec, art institute of chicago

items.title: Moulin de la Galette
items.description_narrative: At a railing in the foreground, four figures in dark coats and hats lean together in conversation while a crowded dance hall blurs into loose green shadow behind them. Lautrec picks out just a few faces sharply, a woman's pale collar, a shock of red hair, and lets the rest dissolve.
items.tags: cabaret, montmartre, figures, nightlife, interior scene, oil painting

items.title: Mahana no atua (Day of the God)
items.description_narrative: A carved idol with raised arms presides over a shoreline, watching three figures resting at its feet. Below them the beach dissolves into broad, flat bands of pink, yellow, and blue standing in for sand and surf.
items.tags: tahiti, idol, nude figures, flat color, shoreline, symbolism, post-impressionism

items.title: Arlésiennes (Mistral)
items.description_narrative: Two women wrapped in dark blue shawls huddle against the wind at the edge of a garden, one cradling her hands close to her chest. Beyond a red picket fence, tall orange conical shapes rise beside a distant fountain, and two more figures walk along a path in the background.
items.tags: arles, mistral wind, bold color blocks, garden scene

items.title: Woman in Front of a Still Life by Cézanne
items.description_narrative: A young woman in a pink and white blouse sits in a floral-upholstered chair, her hand resting near a knife on a white cloth. Behind her, a still life of fruit hangs on the wall above a bowl and a stemmed glass. Gauguin painted this portrait of Marie Lagadu in 1890; it belongs to the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: portrait, still life, floral chair, fruit, interior, oil painting, homage

items.title: Bathers at Asnières
items.description_narrative: Bathers wade and sit along a riverbank in short, choppy strokes of blue and green, sailboats drifting on the water behind them. This oil sketch is Seurat's study for his larger composition, painted in 1883-84 and now in the National Gallery.
items.tags: bathers, riverbank, seine, study, sailboats, neo-impressionism
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.

items.title: Boy in a Red Waistcoat
items.description_narrative: A young man in a bright red waistcoat rests one hand on his hip, his gaze turned toward the viewer beneath a wide-brimmed hat, a pale curtain draped behind him. Cézanne painted this portrait around 1889; it's now at the National Gallery of Art.
items.tags: portrait, red waistcoat, young man, wide-brimmed hat, cézanne, national gallery of art

items.title: Flowing Water in the Woods
items.description_narrative: Dappled greens and golds trace a stream curving through dense woodland, the water barely distinguishable from the reflected foliage around it. Cézanne painted this in 1895; it belongs to the Cleveland Museum of Art.
items.tags: landscape, stream, woodland, reflections, cleveland museum of art

items.title: Still Life with Fruit
items.description_narrative: Four pieces of fruit, a pale pear, a pale green apple, a golden quince, and a blushing peach, sit loosely grouped on a bare tabletop. The muted gray wall behind leaves the fruit's soft color the sole focus of the small canvas.
items.tags: still life, fruit, oil painting

items.title: Still Life with Blue Pot
items.description_narrative: A blue lidded pot, a small white teapot, and apples rest atop a richly patterned cloth in this watercolor and graphite still life. Cézanne created the work, now held by the Getty Research Institute.
items.tags: still life, blue pot, teapot, fruit, watercolor, drapery, cezanne

items.title: Bibémus Quarry (1898-99)
items.description_narrative: A single tree curves over a rocky quarry wall, its round crown silhouetted against a pale sky. Cézanne returned to this quarry site around 1898; the painting now hangs at the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art.
items.tags: quarry, bibémus, single tree, provence, nelson-atkins museum
items.credit_line: Google Art Project works from the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art

items.title: Young Italian Woman at a Table
items.description_narrative: A young woman rests her head on one hand, elbow propped on a richly patterned cloth thrown over the back of a chair, her gaze lowered in thought. A yellow shawl drapes her shoulders over a loose white blouse and dark skirt. Cézanne painted this portrait in the 1890s; it belongs to the J. Paul Getty Museum.
items.tags: portrait, seated woman, patterned textile, shawl, interior, oil painting
items.credit_line: MAFz12krbdE_tg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Still Life with Apples
items.description_narrative: A single green apple sits apart from a plate heaped with more apples in yellow, green, and red, all arranged on a bare wooden table. The muted gray-blue wall behind keeps all the attention on the fruit's warm color.
items.tags: still life, apples, oil painting
items.credit_line: WAHFm9iO_SGeQg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Abandoned House near Aix-en-Provence
items.description_narrative: A weathered stone house with a rusted tin roof sits half-swallowed by trees, its door standing open and a broken wall crumbling into the undergrowth. Thick, angular brushstrokes of ochre and green build the abandoned structure into the surrounding landscape.
items.tags: abandoned house, provence, rural decay, structured brushwork
items.credit_line: Dallas Museum of Art, online collection

items.title: Trees and House, Provence
items.description_narrative: Bare, gesturing branches part just enough to reveal a Provençal farmhouse, its walls warm ochre and rose under a red tile roof. The tree trunks form tall verticals across the foreground, partly screening the house behind them. Cézanne painted this around 1885; it now hangs in the National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design.
items.tags: landscape, farmhouse, provence, trees, oil painting, ochre, rural architecture
items.credit_line: IAFWl3-k88JZ3g at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum
items.current_repository: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

items.title: Seated Man
items.description_narrative: A man in a flat cap and dark suit sits with a folded newspaper in one hand, a patterned curtain and a cluttered dresser behind him. His heavy-lidded gaze and loosely painted mustache give the portrait a weary, distracted air.
items.tags: portrait, man, newspaper, interior, oil painting
items.credit_line: 2QFehjzwoGoRjw at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum
items.current_repository: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

items.title: Still Life with Onions
items.description_narrative: A cluster of pale onions, some still trailing green stems, surrounds a dark wine bottle and a knife laid across the table's edge. A crumpled white cloth spills over the table, its folds echoing the rounded onions piled upon it.
items.tags: still life, onions, bottle, oil painting
items.credit_line: 4gHsoRzcJ38BlQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Big Trees
items.description_narrative: Two heavy tree trunks arch together, their canopies merging into a blue-grey haze of foliage overhead. Cézanne painted these trees in 1904; the work is now in the Scottish National Gallery.
items.tags: landscape, trees, canopy, late cézanne, scottish national gallery

items.title: Landscape near Melun
items.description_narrative: Tall poplars line a quiet lane leading toward a farmhouse, the scene reduced to soft vertical bands of green and gold. Cézanne painted this in 1879.
items.tags: landscape, poplars, farmhouse, melun, cézanne
items.credit_line: lgHnZhWcptH7Rg at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum

items.title: View of the Château Noir
items.description_narrative: Pale pencil lines outline a cluster of tall, gabled buildings among trees, touched here and there with soft washes of green and blue watercolor. Windows and doorways are barely indicated, and much of the sheet is left blank. Cézanne drew this study in the 1880s; it is now held at Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen.
items.tags: pencil drawing, watercolor, buildings, trees, sketch, architecture, muted palette
items.credit_line: DQGY1JtjyPvAyQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Large Bathers
items.description_narrative: More than a dozen nude bathers recline and gather beneath an arch of tall trees, a church spire faint in the distance across the water. Cézanne painted this monumental composition around 1906; it's held by the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
items.tags: bathers, monumental composition, landscape, late cézanne, philadelphia museum of art
items.credit_line: owGszazN_Evyvw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Still Life: Milk Jug and Fruit on a Table
items.description_narrative: A patterned porcelain jug stands behind a loose heap of apples, a lemon, and other fruit spilling across a dark table. The same green-blue wash covers the wall behind, tying jug, fruit, and background into one quiet tonal range.
items.tags: still life, jug, fruit, oil painting
items.credit_line: uAEu57ynKdy6cA at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum
items.current_repository: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

items.title: Hollow with Trees
items.description_narrative: Faint pencil lines and pale washes of blue and green sketch a wooded hollow, the paper left largely bare. Cézanne made this watercolor in the 1890s; it's held by the Staatliche Kunsthalle Karlsruhe.
items.tags: watercolor, landscape sketch, trees, pencil underdrawing, karlsruhe

items.title: View of the Sea at L'Estaque
items.description_narrative: Tall pines lean across a rocky outcrop, their trunks and branches weaving a loose screen in front of a distant view of red-roofed houses along the shore and a flat blue sea. Cézanne painted this view at L'Estaque in the 1880s; it belongs to the Staatliche Kunsthalle Karlsruhe.
items.tags: pines, rocks, coastal view, sea, l'estaque, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Bathers
items.description_narrative: A group of male bathers stand and crouch along a riverbank under a cloud-filled sky, one wearing pale shorts while others are fully nude, framed by tall trees. Paul Cézanne painted this in oil on canvas in 1890; it belongs to the Musée d'Orsay.
items.tags: bathers, nude figures, landscape, cezanne, post-impressionism, genre art
items.credit_line: UAEXdcwYwPHV5w at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Card Players (multi-figure version)
items.description_narrative: Four men gather around a card table, one standing with a pipe, the other three seated with hats low over their eyes as they study their hands. Cézanne painted this scene around 1890.
items.tags: card players, genre scene, four figures, peasants, cézanne

items.title: Winter Landscape, Giverny
items.description_narrative: Bare, spindly trees stand in a row before a cluster of farmhouses with steep, warm-toned roofs, their branches sketched thin and dark against a heavy blue-grey sky. Patches of pale snow linger on the grass between rust-brown earth. Cézanne painted this winter scene in 1894; it belongs to the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
items.tags: winter landscape, bare trees, farmhouse, snow, giverny, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Still Life: Sugar Bowl and Pears
items.description_narrative: A porcelain jug and lidded sugar bowl stand behind a plate of peaches, with two whole pears and a smaller one arranged loosely beside it. A patterned dish towel, its folds rumpled beneath everything, holds the arrangement together.
items.tags: still life, fruit, jug, sugar bowl, oil painting

items.title: Madame Cézanne in Blue
items.description_narrative: A woman in a pale blue-grey jacket sits quietly before a plain grey wall, her dark hair pulled back and her expression unreadable. Cézanne painted this portrait around 1890.
items.tags: portrait, seated woman, blue jacket, cézanne, muted palette
items.credit_line: rQHy_QckFYI03A at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Terrace at the Garden at Les Lauves
items.description_narrative: Potted plants on low stone walls frame a hazy view of distant hills, rendered in pale, translucent washes of blue and green. Bare tree trunks rise at the edges of the composition, most of the paper left untouched to suggest bright, open air.
items.tags: garden, terrace, watercolor, landscape
items.credit_line: swHLND9wt1UzlQ at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum

items.title: Standing Male Bather; Puget's Atlas
items.description_narrative: Two nude male figures are sketched from behind in dark pencil, one hand raised to the chin in each, standing side by side. A faint, unfinished third study trails off to the left, left as loose scribbled lines.
items.tags: sketch, nude figures, drawing, study
items.credit_line: UAFdNolZp0zsCw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Card Players (The Metropolitan Museum of Art)
items.description_narrative: Two men face off across a small table, cards and a wine bottle between them, one drawing on a long pipe. Cézanne painted this pared-down version in the 1890s; it hangs in the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
items.tags: card players, two figures, pipe, genre scene, metropolitan museum

items.title: Chestnut Trees at Jas de Bouffan in Winter
items.description_narrative: Bare chestnut trees stand in orderly rows across a green winter lawn, a pale mountain peak rising between their trunks. Cézanne painted this scene in 1880; it belongs to the Minneapolis Institute of Art.
items.tags: landscape, bare trees, winter, jas de bouffan, minneapolis institute of art
items.credit_line: IQE2o8CN-L_Hjw at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum

items.title: Village Square
items.description_narrative: A row of trimmed, umbrella-shaped trees lines a pale path, their trunks marching in strict perspective toward a church spire and a huddle of pale houses beyond. Rooftops of grey slate and warm ochre catch the light under a hazy sky. Cézanne painted this view of Melun around 1881; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: pollarded trees, village, church spire, rooftops, landscape, avenue, oil painting

items.title: Gardanne
items.description_narrative: A hilltop bell tower rises above a jumble of red-roofed houses, the whole village compressed into interlocking geometric planes. Cézanne painted this view in the 1880s; it's held by the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
items.tags: village, gardanne, bell tower, red roofs, metropolitan museum

items.title: Landscape in Provence
items.description_narrative: A heavy bank of purple-grey storm clouds looms over green fields and clustered trees, painted in loose, urgent strokes. Cézanne painted this around 1895-1900; it's held by the Museum of Fine Arts, Budapest.
items.tags: landscape, storm clouds, fields, provence, museum of fine arts budapest
items.credit_line: 9QEua6E3lM0Q0g at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Turn in the Road
items.description_narrative: A tan road curves sharply between a stone wall and a cluster of houses, their red and grey roofs just visible through dense green trees. Two slender tree trunks rise at the bend of the road, framing the turn itself rather than any single building. Cézanne painted this scene about 1881; it is now in the Museum of Fine Arts Boston.
items.tags: winding road, village, rooftops, trees, landscape, stone wall, oil painting
items.credit_line: cAFxgW7NKS6wxg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Bather
items.description_narrative: A lone bather stands with his weight shifted onto one leg, arms akimbo, against a hazy blue-green backdrop with almost no other detail. Cézanne painted this figure around 1885; it now belongs to the Museum of Modern Art.
items.tags: bather, male nude, solitary figure, blue-green palette, standing pose, museum of modern art

items.title: View of the Bay of Marseille with the Village of Saint-Henri
items.description_narrative: Terraced gardens and red-roofed houses spill down a green hillside toward a hazy blue bay, backed by distant mountains. A tall chimney and a slender church tower rise faintly above the rooftops on the horizon. Cézanne painted this view of the Bay of Marseille and the village of Saint-Henri around 1883; it belongs to the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
items.tags: coastal view, marseille, hillside, terraced gardens, bay, landscape, oil painting

items.title: The Pond
items.description_narrative: Figures in pale, full-skirted dresses and suits gather on a grassy bank above the water, while a man in shirtsleeves leans down toward a small rowboat below. A tin pail sits forgotten in the grass among them, the whole scene dappled with quick strokes of sunlight.
items.tags: pond, figures, rowboat, riverbank, leisure, oil painting
items.credit_line: bQGogpTxxML5Bg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Woman with a Coffeepot
items.description_narrative: A woman in a blue dress sits stiffly upright, hands folded in her lap, before a paneled door and a strip of floral wallpaper. Beside her, a white cup and saucer and a tall metal coffeepot rest on a small table. Cézanne painted this portrait around 1895; it belongs to the Musée d'Orsay.
items.tags: portrait, seated woman, coffeepot, interior, still life, oil painting
items.credit_line: sQEIYLkU0bt2GQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire Seen from the Bibémus Quarry
items.description_narrative: The mountain's sharp triangular peak appears between dark trees and the tawny stone of a quarry in the foreground. The quarry's blocky rock faces echo the mountain's own faceted geometry.
items.tags: quarry, mountain, rocks, provence, landscape, oil painting
items.credit_line: 1. The Yorck Project (2002) 10.000 Meisterwerke der Malerei (DVD-ROM), distributed by DIRECTMEDIA Publishing GmbH. ISBN: 3936122202. 2. Google Arts & Culture

items.title: The Toilette
items.description_narrative: A nude woman stands with her arms raised to her hair, a second figure bent over a dressing table mirror beside her. Loose, sketchy strokes of pink, blue, and lavender fill the room, leaving the furniture and drapery only half-resolved.
items.tags: toilette, nude figure, dressing table, interior, oil painting

items.title: The Village of Gardanne
items.description_narrative: A church tower and clustered rooftops crown a hillside town, the buildings simplified into blocks of ochre, rose, and grey beneath a pale sky. Bare and leafy trees frame the foreground, their branches sketched in dark, angular strokes. Cézanne painted this view of Gardanne in the 1880s; it belongs to the Brooklyn Museum.
items.tags: hilltop village, church tower, rooftops, gardanne, landscape, trees, oil painting
items.credit_line: tgHguAmF6k2-EA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Buffet
items.description_narrative: A dark wooden sideboard holds cups, a jar, and an apple on its upper shelf, while oranges and biscuits spill across a white cloth on the shelf below. Cézanne painted this in 1877; it's now in the Museum of Fine Arts, Budapest.
items.tags: still life, sideboard, oranges, biscuits, cézanne, museum of fine arts budapest
items.credit_line: 4gEUmvREVP4r8Q at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Still Life with a Dessert
items.description_narrative: A dark glass bottle and a tall stemmed glass rise behind a loose scatter of pears, apples, and a knife on a white cloth. The background falls into deep brown shadow, broken only by a sliver of red drapery at the right edge.
items.tags: still life, fruit, glass, bottle, oil painting

items.title: Achille Emperaire
items.description_narrative: A man with a mop of dark curly hair and wide, searching eyes sits swallowed by an oversized floral armchair, his stocking feet propped on a small footstool. His name and profession are inscribed above him in bold gold letters, as if on a formal announcement.
items.tags: armchair, inscribed lettering, expressive pose, portrait
items.credit_line: nAExIaAoXjOVbw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Red Rock
items.description_narrative: A single rust-red boulder juts from a hillside of layered brown and gray rock, dwarfing the dark pines that crowd around it. Thick, faceted brushstrokes give the stone a weight and solidity that borders on architecture.
items.tags: landscape, rock formation, provence, oil painting
items.credit_line: 5QH9Zae_lPTZzA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Bibémus Quarry
items.description_narrative: Orange quarry stone rises in blocky, sunlit faces among dark pines, the rock itself painted with the same faceted strokes Cézanne used for figures. He painted this quarry scene around 1895; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: quarry, orange rock, pines, provence, barnes foundation, cézanne

items.title: Still Life with Milk Jug and Fruit
items.description_narrative: A porcelain jug decorated with a green leaf motif stands beside a stemmed glass, with a loose pile of apples and oranges spilling from a white plate. A richly patterned cloth, dark red and brown, drapes behind the arrangement.
items.tags: still life, jug, fruit, patterned cloth, oil painting
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington D.C.

items.title: Church at Montigny-sur-Loing
items.description_narrative: A church tower with a small steeple rises above a hillside village of red-roofed houses. Cézanne painted this in 1898; it's held by the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: village, church tower, red roofs, montigny-sur-loing, barnes foundation

items.title: Straw-Trimmed Vase, Sugar Bowl and Apples
items.description_narrative: A tall ceramic vase and a small lidded sugar bowl stand behind a loose scatter of apples on a bare wooden tabletop. The composition tilts sharply, the table's edge cutting a steep diagonal across the lower corner of the canvas.
items.tags: still life, vase, sugar bowl, apples, oil painting
items.credit_line: kwEpEFvxnyne9A at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Ginger Jar
items.description_narrative: A tall ceramic ginger jar with dark blue floral bands stands alone on a bare tabletop against a warm brown ground. Cézanne painted this in 1895; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: still life, ginger jar, ceramic, tabletop, barnes foundation

items.title: Madame Cézanne in a Red Armchair
items.description_narrative: A woman in a grey jacket with a pale blue bow sits stiffly in a red armchair patterned with small crosses, her hands folded in her lap. Cézanne painted this portrait around 1877; it's held by the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston.
items.tags: portrait, red armchair, seated woman, cézanne, museum of fine arts boston
items.credit_line: bQHHPF3jTJ5okg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Cistern in the Grounds of Château Noir
items.description_narrative: Thick vertical brushstrokes of blue, white, and orange suggest a stone structure rising among rock and foliage, the forms nearly abstracted. Cézanne painted this around 1900.
items.tags: landscape, château noir, abstraction, provence, late cézanne

items.title: Portrait of Madame Cézanne
items.description_narrative: A woman with long, center-parted brown hair looks slightly away, a striped dark scarf wrapped loosely at her throat. The palette stays muted throughout, grays and soft greens dominating both the sitter and the wall behind her.
items.tags: portrait, woman, muted palette, oil painting
items.credit_line: pQGpXXB6A018rA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Bowl and Milk-Jug
items.description_narrative: A tall pale jug stands beside a white bowl painted with green leaves and a thin orange rim, set on a bare tabletop against dark drapery. Cézanne painted this simple pairing in the 1870s; it belongs to the Artizon Museum.
items.tags: still life, jug, bowl, tabletop, early cézanne, artizon museum
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – Image

items.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire and Château Noir
items.description_narrative: A cluster of ochre stone buildings emerges from dense green foliage, with the pale form of Mont Sainte-Victoire rising softly behind. Cezanne renders the mountain almost as a single color note, the same blue-gray as the sky it merges into.
items.tags: mountain, provence, buildings, landscape, oil painting, post-impressionism
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – Image

items.title: Self-Portrait in a Soft Hat
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a felt hat looks out sideways from a mottled green-and-plum ground, his gaze steady and slightly guarded. Cezanne builds the face from patches of warm ochre and cool shadow rather than smooth blending.
items.tags: self-portrait, man, hat, beard, oil painting
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – Image

items.title: Banks of the Marne
items.description_narrative: A cluster of tall trees leans over a quiet riverbank, their reflections rippling across the still water below. A small boat is tucked along the shore, the whole scene painted in soft, blended greens and blues.
items.tags: marne river, riverside trees, reflections, boat
items.credit_line: SAEWBj7YSSuNOA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
items.current_repository: Art Gallery of New South Wales

items.title: Country House by a River
items.description_narrative: A pale house nestles among tall trees beside a quiet stream, its reflection dissolving into ripples of green and gold. Cézanne painted this around 1890; the Israel Museum now holds it.
items.tags: landscape, house, river, reflection, israel museum
items.credit_line: ogELT1B3t3lsJw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Trees and Road
items.description_narrative: One tree dominates the canvas: bare, gesturing limbs on one side, a leafy green crown on the other. A pale road crosses the middle distance in front of a dense wall of green foliage. Cézanne painted this view around 1890; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: single tree, landscape, road, bare branches, foliage, barnes foundation, oil painting

items.title: The Spring House
items.description_narrative: A small building with a red tile roof sits half-hidden among tall, slender trees and open green fields. The composition is built almost entirely from verticals, the trees and building corners all echoing one another.
items.tags: landscape, building, trees, fields, oil painting

items.title: Seven Bathers
items.description_narrative: Seven pale, loosely outlined figures gather beneath an arch of blue-green trees, some standing, others seated or crouched at the water's edge. The bodies are built from the same quick, dark contour lines as the branches overhead, blurring figure and landscape together.
items.tags: bathers, nude figures, landscape, oil painting, post-impressionism

items.title: Château Noir
items.description_narrative: A yellow stone house with arched windows rises above a slope thick with dark green pines. Cézanne painted this in 1903; it's now at the Museum of Modern Art.
items.tags: landscape, château noir, provence, pines, museum of modern art

items.title: Farmyard
items.description_narrative: A cluster of farm buildings with red and grey roofs sits among trees on a sloping green field. Cézanne painted this farmyard in 1879; it's held by the Musée d'Orsay.
items.tags: farmyard, rural buildings, provence, landscape, musée d'orsay
items.credit_line: FgHAIVqI2MSSow at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Morning View of L'Estaque Against the Sunlight
items.description_narrative: A hillside village of orange tile roofs nestles among dense trees, glimpsed past a heavy pine bough curving in from the right. The palette stays warm and close, the rooftops barely distinguishable in tone from the foliage around them.
items.tags: landscape, village, rooftops, pine tree, provence, oil painting
items.credit_line: 9AHLNI1V7mkxNg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Portrait of a Peasant
items.description_narrative: A man in a straw boater and dark blue coat sits on a low stone wall, hands loosely clasped, a screen of trees rising behind him. The greens of the foliage bleed into his jacket, folding the figure into the landscape around him.
items.tags: portrait, man, straw hat, outdoor setting, oil painting

items.title: Pines and Rocks (Fontainebleau?)
items.description_narrative: Several tall, bare pine trunks rise like columns from a jumble of pale boulders, their crowns dissolving into a screen of blue-green needles overhead. The rocks and tree trunks share the same faceted, blocky handling, as if carved from the same material.
items.tags: pine forest, rocks, fontainebleau, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Road Leading to the Lake
items.description_narrative: A dirt road curves down between two walls of trees toward a scatter of rooftops and a pale strip of water in the distance. The trees on either side lean inward, framing the view like a tunnel of green and gold.
items.tags: road, landscape, trees, lake, oil painting
items.credit_line: lwGKeFh4730wfA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Still Life with Cherries and Peaches
items.description_narrative: A heap of bright red cherries fills a white plate at left, while a second plate of pale yellow peaches sits beside it on a rumpled white cloth. A green jar rises behind them against a teal-and-brown backdrop.
items.tags: still life, cherries, peaches, oil painting

items.title: Landscape
items.description_narrative: Rolling green countryside stretches beneath a pale sky, a few structures barely legible among patches of color. Cézanne painted this in the 1880s; it's held by the Ohara Museum of Art.
items.tags: landscape, countryside, provence, ohara museum
items.credit_line: SAEaiIw2vE7PKA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Studies of Three Figures, Including a Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: On a single sheet, a nude woman stands at left, a bearded man's head appears at upper right, and a reclining figure curls at bottom, all in loose pencil. None of the three studies is brought to any real finish, left as quick exploratory sketches sharing the same page.
items.tags: sketch, figure studies, drawing, pencil
items.credit_line: 9wEjptV6M34q2Q at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Afternoon in Naples
items.description_narrative: A servant lifts a curtain and offers a tray of refreshments to three reclining nude figures sprawled across a white sheet. A shelf of glassware and a patterned vase glow through an opening in the wall behind them.
items.tags: nude figures, servant, interior scene, still life elements
items.credit_line: CQF3JgE-l2cTmw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Peppermint Bottle
items.description_narrative: A dark bottle with a red-wrapped neck and a tall glass carafe rise above a loose arrangement of apples, a lemon, and a pear on a rumpled blue-and-white cloth. The cool gray-green wall behind throws the pale cloth and fruit into quiet relief.
items.tags: still life, bottle, fruit, carafe, oil painting
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D. C., online collection

items.title: Portrait of Hortense Cézanne-Fiquet, the Artist's Wife
items.description_narrative: In quick pencil lines, a woman's head and shoulders emerge from the page, a ribboned headscarf tied beneath her chin. The sketch is left loose and unfinished, with only the face brought to any real finish.
items.tags: portrait, woman, pencil sketch, headscarf
items.credit_line: RwHifflh5Djzyg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Houses in Provence: The Riaux Valley near L'Estaque
items.description_narrative: Terraced fields and stone walls step down a sunlit hillside toward a scatter of houses, all rendered in warm ochre and green patches. Cézanne painted this view around 1883.
items.tags: landscape, terraced fields, houses, l'estaque, provence
items.credit_line: 1QFGQA0MaQQxVw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Kiss of the Muse
items.description_narrative: A winged muse leans down to kiss a poet slumped over his desk, rendered in smooth, dark academic tones. This is a copy Cézanne made after a painting by Félix Nicolas Frillié, around 1860.
items.tags: copy after frillié, allegory, muse, early cézanne, academic style

items.title: Fruit and a Jug on a Table
items.description_narrative: A squat clay jug stands beside a loose pile of apples, oranges, and a lemon on a bare tabletop, the wall behind rendered in soft green strokes. Cézanne painted this around 1890; it's held by the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston.
items.tags: still life, jug, fruit, tabletop, museum of fine arts boston
items.credit_line: 9wFTjvdxsakvLw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Farm in Normandy (Le Clos Normand, Hattenville)
items.description_narrative: A slender bare tree stands before a stone farmhouse tucked among leafy trees, seen from a shaded doorway. Cézanne painted this around 1885.
items.tags: farmhouse, normandy, bare tree, rural architecture, cézanne

items.title: Portrait of Ambroise Vollard
items.description_narrative: A man in a dark suit and bow tie sits with his hands folded in his lap, glancing slightly downward. Behind him, framed pictures and glass jars on a shelf hint at the art dealer's gallery around him.
items.tags: portrait, man, gallery, bow tie, oil painting

items.title: Apotheosis of Delacroix
items.description_narrative: A robed figure is lifted skyward by an angel while a small crowd below applauds, one man leaning on a stick and gesturing upward. Loosely brushed clouds and a wooded hillside frame the small, sketch-like composition.
items.tags: allegory, apotheosis, sketch, symbolic scene

items.title: The Banks of the Marne (Villa on the Bank of a River)
items.description_narrative: A white villa with a peaked tower rises above dense trees along a riverbank, its reflection rippling across the still water below. Paul Cézanne painted this Post-Impressionist view of the Marne river in 1888; the canvas is now held by the Hermitage Museum.
items.tags: landscape, cézanne, post-impressionism, river, villa, reflection

items.title: Bend in the Road through the Forest (La Route tournante en sous-bois)
items.description_narrative: A sandy path curves away between sunlit trees, the dappled greens of the woodland rendered in loose, textured strokes. Painted around 1873–75, the woodland scene is attributed to Paul Cézanne and titled La Route tournante en sous-bois.
items.tags: landscape, forest, path, post-impressionism, oil on canvas, woodland
items.current_repository: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York

items.title: Bather at the Seashore
items.description_narrative: A seated bather rests beneath a leaning pine at the water's edge, painted quickly in small, loose strokes across a modest canvas. Cézanne's version belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: bather, seashore, small canvas, seated figure, loose brushwork, barnes foundation

items.title: Avenue at Chantilly
items.description_narrative: A tunnel of overlapping tree branches arches over a sandy path, framing a glimpse of distant houses and pale sky at the far end. Dense, overlapping strokes of green build layer upon layer of shaded canopy.
items.tags: tree tunnel, avenue, layered brushwork

items.title: Landscape with Poplars
items.description_narrative: Tall poplars rise beside a quiet country house, their trunks and leaves painted in loose, overlapping strokes of green. Cézanne painted this in the 1880s; it belongs to the National Gallery, London.
items.tags: landscape, poplars, country house, cézanne, national gallery london

items.title: The Stove in the Studio
items.description_narrative: A squat iron stove sits before an empty wooden easel, its metal chimney pipe rising straight up through the dark studio. Small framed pictures and a palette hang loosely on the wall above, the only bright notes in an otherwise shadowed room.
items.tags: studio, stove, interior, dark palette, oil painting

items.title: The Card Player
items.description_narrative: A mustached man in a broad hat leans over a table, his hands studying a card just out of view, painted almost entirely in browns against a bare wall. Cézanne painted this single figure around 1892; it's in the Musée d'Orsay.
items.tags: card player, single figure, genre scene, muted palette, musée d'orsay
items.credit_line: 8AEfnGUA8A-oNQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Maison Maria with a View of Château Noir
items.description_narrative: A weathered yellow house rises from a tangle of green brush, its walls the warmest note in an otherwise cool, blue-green landscape. Two bare trees frame the view, and the pale silhouette of a mountain shows through a gap in the foliage at right.
items.tags: landscape, house, provence, trees, mountain, oil painting, post-impressionism
items.credit_line: 0AHR8NyHgwPA6Q at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Turning Road at Montgeroult
items.description_narrative: Houses with peach and orange-tiled roofs climb a hillside above a curving road, packed tightly against dark green trees under a hazy blue sky. Cézanne painted this view of Montgeroult in 1898; the canvas now hangs at the Museum of Modern Art.
items.tags: hillside village, rooftops, winding road, montgeroult, landscape, trees, oil painting

items.title: The Bathers (Large Plate)
items.description_narrative: Rendered as a loose, cross-hatched sketch rather than a painting, bathers gather in a landscape beneath a pine. A lithograph Cézanne made around 1896, now among the prints at the National Gallery of Art.
items.tags: bathers, lithograph, print, cross-hatching, landscape, national gallery of art
items.credit_line: xAGaOEFY_zJFGw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Pot and Soup Tureen
items.description_narrative: A ceramic pitcher, a blue-and-white soup tureen, and scattered pieces of fruit crowd a draped tabletop in this pencil and watercolor still life. Cézanne drew it around 1889; it belongs to the Matsukata Collection at Japan's National Museum of Western Art.
items.tags: still life, pitcher, tureen, fruit, watercolor, tabletop, cezanne
items.credit_line: HAE0LVmKMSiTZg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Woman at a Mirror
items.description_narrative: A reclining nude woman holds a small round mirror aloft in one hand, her red-gold hair loose across her shoulders, the whole figure built from broad, sweeping strokes of blue-grey and warm flesh tones. The background dissolves into dark diagonal brushwork, giving no sense of a specific room. Cézanne painted this figure between 1866 and 1867.
items.tags: nude figure, mirror, reclining pose, expressive brushwork, dark background, oil painting

items.title: The Eternal Feminine
items.description_narrative: A crowd of men in dark clothing - among them a bishop, a painter at an easel, and trumpeters - kneel and reach toward a nude woman enthroned atop a tent-like canopy. Cézanne painted this around 1877; it's held by the J. Paul Getty Museum.
items.tags: allegory, nude figure, crowd scene, satire, getty museum
items.credit_line: LAE94FbH0-T4_w at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Self-Portrait with a Straw Hat
items.description_narrative: A wide-brimmed straw hat frames a heavily bearded face, painted almost entirely in warm yellows and browns against a matching yellow ground. Only the dark eyes and jacket break the picture's near-monochrome palette.
items.tags: self-portrait, straw hat, beard, yellow palette, oil painting

items.title: Milk Can and Apples
items.description_narrative: A tall metal milk can anchors a loose still life of apples, pears, and a lemon spilling across a rumpled white cloth. The cloth's folds catch the same cool green light as the wall behind it.
items.tags: still life, fruit, milk can, cloth, oil painting, post-impressionism

items.title: House in Provence
items.description_narrative: Blue mountains rise behind a two-story house with a red roof, its windows and walls broken into simplified geometric planes. Cézanne painted this around 1890; it's held by the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: house, mountains, provence, geometric forms, barnes foundation
items.credit_line: HAEcLEiIhDAl-Q at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Portrait of Antoine Valabrègue
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a gray waistcoat and black bow tie sits before a plain gray wall, his reddish beard picked out in warm, loose strokes. His gaze is direct but slightly wary, meeting the viewer without quite settling on them.
items.tags: portrait, man, beard, bow tie, oil painting
items.credit_line: YQGJT09pbLPLTQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Autumn Landscape
items.description_narrative: A row of slender trees marches across a golden autumn field, birds scattered across a lavender-tinted sky. Warm oranges and yellows dominate the canopy, painted in dense, textured strokes.
items.tags: autumn landscape, golden foliage, textured brushwork

items.title: House and Trees
items.description_narrative: A pale house with a steep red roof sits behind a stand of trees, glimpsed through gaps in the tall trunks. Cézanne painted this in the 1890s; it's held by the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: house, trees, provence, landscape, barnes foundation

items.title: Hunting Cabin in Provence
items.description_narrative: A small stone cabin with a red tile roof sits framed by tall pines against a hazy blue mountain backdrop. Cézanne painted this in 1889; it's held by the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: cabin, pines, provence landscape, mountains, barnes foundation

items.title: Railroad Cut
items.description_narrative: A pale rock cutting rises against a cloud-streaked sky, a dark screen of pines beside it and a tiny figure walking the path below. A slender pole topped with a round signal disc marks the railway line threading through the cut.
items.tags: railroad, rock cutting, landscape, signal, oil painting

items.title: River Bend
items.description_narrative: A pale stream curves between dark rocks and overhanging trees, a small figure in white and red standing quietly at the water's edge. Storm-blue clouds gather above the tree line, the only real light coming from the pale rocks and water below.
items.tags: river, forest, landscape, figure, oil painting

items.title: The Allée at Marines
items.description_narrative: A row of bare, gnarled trees lines a grassy path receding into a dense screen of dark foliage. Cool blues and greens dominate the composition, the thin winter branches drawn in sharp, dark lines against the muted sky.
items.tags: tree-lined path, winter trees, landscape, cool palette

items.title: The Bellevue Plain (The Red Earth)
items.description_narrative: Rust-red soil cuts across a green plain below a cluster of farm buildings and a line of hazy hills. Cézanne painted this plain around 1891; the Barnes Foundation now holds it.
items.tags: landscape, red soil, farm buildings, plain, provence, barnes foundation

items.title: The Chaîne de l'Étoile Mountains with the Pilon du Roi
items.medium: Watercolor and graphite on laid paper
items.description_narrative: Pale washes of blue and green sketch out rolling hills and a distant mountain range, with pencil underdrawing still visible beneath the thin color. Cézanne made this watercolor around 1885; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: watercolor, landscape sketch, mountains, pencil underdrawing, barnes foundation

items.title: Trees
items.description_narrative: Loose pencil lines sketch a tangle of bare branches, with a few strokes of pale green, blue, and ochre watercolor scattered among them. Much of the paper is left bare, standing in for sky and light. Cézanne drew this study of trees around 1900; it is now held at the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: trees, forest, pencil drawing, watercolor, landscape sketch, muted palette, barnes foundation

items.title: Olympia
items.description_narrative: A reclining nude woman is attended by a maid, while a top-hatted man looks on, sketched loosely in watercolor and graphite. Cézanne made this drawing around 1877, using faint washes of color over quick pencil lines rather than filling in the scene.
items.tags: nude, drawing, watercolor, figure study, cezanne, interior scene

items.title: Four Peaches on a Plate
items.description_narrative: Four ripe peaches, blushed pink and gold, sit heaped on a white-and-blue plate atop a patterned cloth. Cézanne painted this in 1892; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: still life, peaches, plate, fruit, barnes foundation

items.title: Fruit on a Table
items.description_narrative: Peaches and a pear rest on a plate and a white cloth atop a wooden stool, a second pear set apart on the bare fabric. Cézanne painted this in 1891; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: still life, peaches, pear, stool, barnes foundation

items.title: Plate of Fruit on a Chair
items.description_narrative: A single pear stands upright among rounder apples and pears, piled loosely on a shallow plate balanced on a woven chair seat. The chair's cane pattern and the tablecloth's diagonal fold give the small scene an off-kilter energy.
items.tags: still life, pear, apples, chair, oil painting

items.title: Bottle and Fruits
items.description_narrative: A dark wine bottle stands over oranges and lemons heaped on a crumpled white cloth. Cézanne painted this around 1890; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: still life, bottle, oranges, lemons, tablecloth, barnes foundation

items.title: A Table Corner
items.description_narrative: A round tabletop crowded with fruit, glassware, and patterned linens is glimpsed at an oblique angle, its corner nearly filling the frame. Loosely brushed patterns on the drapery echo the fruit's rounded forms without describing any single object in detail.
items.tags: still life, table, fruit, patterned cloth, oil painting

items.title: Gardanne (Horizontal View)
items.description_narrative: A hill town spreads along a ridge beneath a pale sky, its bell tower the tallest point above rows of red-roofed houses and cypress trees. Cézanne painted this view in the 1880s; it's held by the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: village, gardanne, bell tower, cypress trees, barnes foundation

items.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire (Study I)
items.description_narrative: Bare, wintry branches claw across the foreground against a pale mountain rendered almost entirely in blues and whites. Below, patchwork fields in ochre and green stretch toward a scattering of rooftops at the mountain's foot.
items.tags: mountain, bare trees, fields, provence, landscape, oil painting
items.credit_line: dgFm740uqOu5Cw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire (Study II)
items.description_narrative: The mountain looms close and pyramidal, its streaked flank catching warm ochre light against a churning blue-green sky. A village presses up against dense trees at the base of the slope below it.
items.tags: mountain, village, provence, landscape, oil painting, post-impressionism
items.credit_line: sgHnFanUtHKRBQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Bathers (Small Group)
items.description_narrative: A cluster of bathers rests and stretches beneath heavy summer trees, one figure raising her arms overhead against a screen of green. Cézanne painted this group in the 1880s; it now hangs in the Ohara Museum of Art.
items.tags: bathers, group figures, summer trees, seated figures, cézanne, ohara museum
items.credit_line: QwHJjmBqKey0yg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Fields at Bellevue (second version)
items.description_narrative: Loose patches of green, gold, and violet suggest a field and hedgerow beneath a heavy, storm-touched sky, the forms nearly dissolving into pure color. Cézanne painted this in the 1890s; it's held by the Phillips Collection.
items.tags: landscape, abstract brushwork, field, storm sky, phillips collection
items.credit_line: YQGijCcy_62wCQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Ginger Pot with Pomegranate and Pears
items.description_narrative: A squat patterned jar sits behind a scatter of pears and a split pomegranate, its red flesh just visible against a grey-blue wall. Cézanne painted this small still life in 1893; it's held by the Phillips Collection.
items.tags: still life, pomegranate, pears, ceramic jar, phillips collection
items.credit_line: iwEUaDqSZWy7vg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Landscape: Road with Trees in Rocky Terrain
items.description_narrative: A pale rock face looms beside a winding path shaded by dense pines, sunlight breaking through in patches of gold. Cézanne painted this scene in 1870 or 1871.
items.tags: landscape, rocky terrain, pines, path, cézanne
items.credit_line: 1QHHYmLBFgOI7w at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum

items.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire (Study III)
items.description_narrative: A pine bough curves across the top of the canvas like a natural frame, opening onto a valley of farmhouses and fields. Far off, a stone viaduct's arches step across the base of the pale, distant mountain.
items.tags: mountain, valley, pine tree, viaduct, provence, landscape
items.credit_line: kgF8wo7pt6bJsA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Seated Woman in Blue
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dark blue hat and jacket sits beside a golden curtain, one hand resting on a folded yellow paper in her lap. The warm gold of the drapery and the cool blue of her clothing divide the small canvas almost evenly.
items.tags: portrait, woman, blue jacket, interior, oil painting
items.credit_line: 1AG7I2MOyfdjdw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: A balding, bearded man gazes at the viewer with a steady, direct expression against a mottled olive-green background. Paul Cézanne painted this self-portrait in oil paint on canvas during the 1870s. It is held in the Phillips Collection.
items.tags: self-portrait, cezanne, post-impressionism, oil painting, figure study, introspective, portraiture, phillips collection
items.credit_line: The Phillips Collection 0288, "Portrait de l'artiste"; Wikidata Q23939459 (Google Art Project)

items.title: The Garden at Les Lauves
items.description_narrative: Loose strokes of violet, green, and gold barely resolve into a hedge and lawn beneath a heavy sky, the garden reduced to almost pure color and gesture. Cézanne painted this around 1906; it's held by the Phillips Collection.
items.tags: garden, abstract brushwork, late cézanne, les lauves, phillips collection
items.credit_line: SAEhQn_adsPLfg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: On the Banks of a River
items.description_narrative: A row of houses and a red-roofed building sit behind a screen of overhanging trees, their reflections rippling in bright blue water below. Loose swathes of gold in the foreground bank contrast with the cooler greens and blues of the far shore.
items.tags: river, village, reflection, landscape, oil painting, post-impressionism

items.title: Melting Snow, Fontainebleau
items.description_narrative: Bare tree trunks crisscross in dark verticals against patches of melting snow clinging to rocks and undergrowth. The forest floor becomes a mosaic of white, green, and violet shadow, with almost no sky visible through the tangle of branches.
items.tags: winter, forest, snow, trees, boulders, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Riverbank
items.description_narrative: A row of pale houses and trees lines a riverbank, their forms echoed in soft, broken reflections on the water below. The whole scene is painted with the same loose, unblended strokes above and below the waterline, blurring where land ends and reflection begins.
items.tags: river, houses, reflection, landscape, oil painting

items.title: The Bend in the Road
items.description_narrative: A pale road curves between rocky slopes and dense trees, the paint laid down in short parallel strokes. Cézanne painted this scene in the 1900s.
items.tags: landscape, road, trees, late cézanne, parallel brushstrokes

items.title: Still Life with Teapot
items.description_narrative: A patterned jug and a small lidded white vessel stand behind a loose gathering of peaches and apples on a rumpled cloth. The muted green-gray background keeps all the warmth of the composition in the fruit itself.
items.tags: still life, fruit, jug, oil painting
items.credit_line: This image is uploaded as image number 2368 at Amgueddfa Cymru Images.This tag does not indicate the copyright status of the attached work. A normal copyright tag is still required. See Commons:Licensing.

items.title: At the Water's Edge
items.description_narrative: A single tall tree bends over a grassy riverbank, its dark trunk anchoring a loosely painted landscape of soft blues and greens. A cluster of rooftops is just visible through the trees on the far bank.
items.tags: riverbank, tree, structured brushwork, landscape

items.title: Portrait of Antoine Valabrègue (alternate version)
items.description_narrative: Dressed almost entirely in black against a dark brown ground, a bearded man sits with his hands loosely clasped, eyes cast down and to the side. Only his white collar and cuffs break the deep, somber tonal range of the rest of the canvas.
items.tags: portrait, man, dark palette, beard, oil painting
items.credit_line: 1. J. Rewald, The Paintings of Paul Cézanne: A Catalogue Raisonné2. National Gallery of Art, Washington, D.C.

items.title: Harlequin
items.description_narrative: A performer in a red-and-black diamond costume and tall white cap stands with hands clasped around gloves, a cane tucked beneath one arm. Cézanne painted this between 1888 and 1890; it belongs to the National Gallery of Art.
items.tags: harlequin, costume figure, commedia dell'arte, cézanne, national gallery of art
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.

items.title: The Road, the Old Wall
items.description_narrative: A long stone wall runs beside a road lined with slender trees, their canopies meeting overhead in patches of green and gold. Rooftops with red-orange tiles cluster just beyond the wall, glimpsed through the trunks.
items.tags: road, wall, village, trees, oil painting

items.title: The Bathers
items.description_narrative: Nude bathers gather among trees along a wooded riverbank, some seated on the grass, one raising her arms to gather her hair. Paul Cézanne painted this scene around 1890. The figures and foliage are built from loose, patterned brushstrokes.
items.tags: bathers, nude figures, landscape, post-impressionism, cezanne, brushwork, trees, riverbank

items.title: The Bedroom (Amsterdam version, 1888)
items.description_narrative: Straw-yellow rush-seated chairs sit near a bed hung with two small portraits, stacked one above the other on the wall. Van Gogh painted this bedroom in Arles in 1888.
items.tags: bedroom interior, arles, van gogh, rush-seated chairs, portraits, 1888

items.title: The Bedroom (Musée d'Orsay version, 1889)
items.description_narrative: Green woven seats top the bedside chairs, and two small portraits hang side by side above a wooden bed with a red coverlet. Van Gogh painted this bedroom in Arles in 1889; it belongs to the Musée d'Orsay.
items.tags: bedroom interior, arles, van gogh, green chairs, portraits, musée d'orsay
items.credit_line: C2RMF: Galerie de tableaux en très haute définition: image page

items.title: The Viaduct at Arles ("The Blue Train")
items.description_narrative: Tall, bare plane trees line a gravel path beside a low blue-topped wall, their trunks catching pale yellow light against a cool blue sky. Two small figures walk together in the distance, with a row of buildings and blue ironwork visible beyond the trees. Van Gogh painted this scene at Arles in March 1888.
items.tags: trees, path, arles, viaduct, spring light, landscape, oil painting
items.credit_line: Cropped from File:Le Train Bleu, by Vincent van Gogh, from C2RMF.jpg, originally C2RMF: Galerie de tableaux en très haute définition: image page

items.title: Farmhouse in Provence
items.description_narrative: A blue-gated stone wall leads to a golden farmhouse under a swirling turquoise sky, red poppies and thistles crowding the path. Van Gogh painted this in 1888; it's held by the National Gallery of Art.
items.tags: farmhouse, provence, poppies, turquoise sky, van gogh, national gallery of art

items.title: Two Poplars in the Alpilles near Saint-Rémy
items.description_narrative: Van Gogh painted these two poplars while a patient at the asylum near Saint-Rémy, soon after returning to working outdoors from confinement to painting in his room. Their gold and green leaves twist upward against a churning, darkening blue sky, laid down in short, charged strokes. A small building and a low stone wall sit at the foot of the trees.
items.tags: poplars, trees, saint-remy, expressive brushwork, sky, landscape, oil painting

items.title: The White House at Night
items.description_narrative: A luminous burst of light blazes in the night sky above a white house with a red tile roof and green shutters, its windows glowing with lamplight. A woman in dark clothing walks along the path in the foreground, while two more figures stand near the gate behind her. Van Gogh painted this nocturne in June 1890; it belongs to the Hermitage Museum.
items.tags: nocturne, house, venus, night sky, figures, moonlight, oil painting

items.title: Portrait of Adeline Ravoux
items.description_narrative: A young girl in a green-blue dress turns her head in profile, ribbon trailing from a matching bow in her hair. Behind her, dark foliage is broken by a spray of white roses picked out in thick, curling strokes.
items.tags: portrait, girl, profile, roses, oil painting

items.title: Spectators in the Arena at Arles
items.description_narrative: A dense crowd fills the stands beneath a glowing orange sky, hats and parasols picked out in quick strokes of color against the packed rows of onlookers. In the foreground, two figures lean close together, isolated from the crowd behind them.
items.tags: crowd, arena, arles, figures, oil painting
items.credit_line: The Museum of Modern Western Art, Inv. Nr. GMNZI: 34
items.current_repository: The Museum of Modern Western Art

items.title: Basket of Sprouting Hyacinth Bulbs
items.description_narrative: Pale hyacinth bulbs push green shoots up out of a woven basket, the palette far more subdued than Van Gogh's flower paintings in bloom. Van Gogh painted this study in 1887; the Van Gogh Museum now holds it.
items.tags: still life, hyacinth bulbs, basket, muted palette, sprouting, van gogh museum

items.title: Bridge in the Rain (after Hiroshige)
items.description_narrative: Rain falls in dense diagonal streaks over a wooden bridge crossing a green river, tiny figures hurrying across with umbrellas, the whole scene framed within a border painted with invented calligraphy-like characters. Van Gogh made this copy after a print by Hiroshige in 1887; it belongs to the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: copy after hiroshige, bridge, rain, japonisme, van gogh museum

items.title: Still Life with Basket of Potatoes (I)
items.description_narrative: A wicker basket brims with dark, earthy potatoes, more spilling loosely across the table around its base. The entire canvas is painted in close, somber greens and browns, the potatoes barely distinguishable from the shadow around them.
items.tags: still life, potatoes, basket, dark palette, oil painting

items.title: Still Life with Basket of Potatoes (II)
items.description_narrative: A single basket of potatoes sits at the center of a dark, close-toned canvas, more tubers scattered on the table around it. The heavy, dry brushwork gives each potato its own weight and shadow despite the overall gloom.
items.tags: still life, potatoes, basket, dark palette, oil painting

items.title: Still Life with Beer Tankards
items.description_narrative: Three stoneware tankards with hinged pewter lids sit on a bare wooden table, one tipped on its side with its lid fallen open. The muted browns and blue-gray bands of the ceramic are the only real color in an otherwise dark composition.
items.tags: still life, tankards, stoneware, dark palette, oil painting

items.title: Basket of Apples
items.description_narrative: Apples and pears tumble from a leaning wicker basket onto a bare wooden table, painted in dim greens and ochres against total darkness. A few pieces of fruit have rolled loose at the basket's edge.
items.tags: still life, basket of fruit, dark background, wicker basket

items.title: Garden with Courting Couples: Square Saint-Pierre
items.description_narrative: Couples stroll and sit beneath blossoming chestnut trees in a public garden, painted in short, feathery strokes of green and pink. Van Gogh painted this in 1887; it's held by the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: garden, couples, chestnut trees, paris, van gogh museum

items.title: Almond Blossom
items.description_narrative: Delicate white almond blossoms cover a network of dark, angular branches set against a flat turquoise sky. The bold black outlines and simplified branch pattern give the close-up view a graphic, decorative quality.
items.tags: almond blossom, turquoise sky, japanese-influenced, botanical

items.title: Basket of Crocus Bulbs
items.description_narrative: Pale, spiky crocus shoots push up from a tangle of dark soil and roots inside a woven basket. Set against a bare, warm-toned ground, the composition focuses entirely on the sprouting bulbs and the rough texture of the basket's rim.
items.tags: crocus bulbs, still life, sprouting plants, woven basket

items.title: Terrace in the Luxembourg Gardens
items.description_narrative: Rows of trees line a sunlit park path where strollers in dark clothing pause beneath dappled shade, a woman in red among them. A low stone balustrade runs along the right edge, separating the path from a wider view of the gardens beyond.
items.tags: park, garden, trees, strollers, oil painting

items.title: The Yellow House
items.description_narrative: A cluster of pale yellow buildings with green shutters lines a dusty street under a deep blue sky, a railway bridge just visible at the right edge. Small figures go about the street, including a woman in a yellow skirt and a child near a café awning. Van Gogh painted this street corner at Arles in September 1888; it belongs to the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: yellow house, street scene, arles, figures, blue sky, cityscape, oil painting

items.title: Portrait of Dr. Gachet
items.description_narrative: He rests his head on his hand, elbow propped on a red table scattered with foxglove, his blue coat and cap set against rolling blue hills. The whole canvas is built from close variations of a single blue, broken only by the warm flesh tones of his face and hands.
items.tags: portrait, man, melancholy, blue palette, foxglove, oil painting
items.credit_line: OQE_w8xp1TtbSw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Basket of Pansies
items.description_narrative: Violet, cream, and yellow pansies crowd a low basket, each bloom built from short, loaded strokes with barely a leaf showing between them. Van Gogh painted this dense bouquet in 1887, now in the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: still life, pansies, basket, impasto, violet and yellow, van gogh museum

items.title: Still Life with Baskets of Potatoes
items.description_narrative: Two baskets of potatoes stand side by side against a nearly black background, their contents spilling into a low, uneven mound across the table. Only faint highlights on the topmost potatoes separate the forms from the surrounding darkness.
items.tags: still life, potatoes, baskets, dark palette, oil painting

items.title: Bobbin Winder
items.description_narrative: A wooden bobbin winder with a large spoked wheel stands in deep shadow, its form barely emerging from near-black greens and browns. Van Gogh painted this in 1885; the Van Gogh Museum owns it.
items.tags: bobbin winder, still life, dark palette, weaving tool, van gogh museum

items.title: Sprig of Flowering Almond Blossom in a Glass
