items.description_narrative: A single branch of white almond blossom leans in a plain drinking glass half full of water, set on a bare wooden table. The pale background is broken only by a thin red line, letting the delicate blossoms stand out against empty space.
items.tags: still life, blossom, flowers, glass, oil painting

items.title: Allotment with Sunflower
items.description_narrative: A tall, top-heavy sunflower leans over a fenced garden plot, its single bloom nodding beside a small shed. Loose wooden fencing zigzags through the composition toward a hazy view of rooftops beyond.
items.tags: sunflower, allotment garden, fencing, rural scene

items.title: Seated Nude
items.description_narrative: A young girl sits nude on a small wooden chair in a bare, dimly lit room, her bare feet pressed together on the floor. The heavy shadow around her leaves only her pale skin and reddish hair picked out with any real light.
items.tags: nude, seated figure, dark interior, oil painting

items.title: Banks of the Seine with the Pont de Clichy in Spring
items.description_narrative: Wildflowers and new spring growth crowd the riverbank in loose dabs of white, pink, and yellow, framed by overhanging branches. The calm water of the Seine is just visible through a gap in the foliage.
items.tags: seine river, spring, wildflowers, riverbank

items.title: A Woman Walking in a Garden
items.description_narrative: A woman in a pale dress and wide straw hat walks through a garden thick with tall grass, her figure nearly swallowed by a dense screen of slender tree trunks behind her. Red and yellow blossoms dot the grass at her feet, with a pale building just visible through the trees. Van Gogh painted this garden scene in 1887.
items.tags: garden, woman, straw hat, flowers, trees, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Harvest in Provence
items.description_narrative: Golden sheaves of wheat rise in tidy stacks across a sunlit field, a lone figure carrying more sheaves past a distant farmhouse. Van Gogh painted this in Arles in June 1888.
items.tags: harvest, wheat field, arles, farmhouse, van gogh

items.title: Portrait of the Postman Joseph Roulin
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a dark blue uniform sits with one hand resting on his knee, his cap lettered POSTES in gold above a broad, ruddy face. Rows of gold buttons march down his double-breasted coat, echoed by the loose blue brushwork of the background.
items.tags: portrait, postman, uniform, beard, blue palette, oil painting

items.title: Shoes
items.description_narrative: A single pair of worn leather boots sits on a diamond-patterned tile floor, laces trailing loose and untied. Thick strokes of ochre and brown build up the creased, scuffed leather in heavy relief.
items.tags: shoes, boots, still life, worn objects, oil painting

items.title: Wheat Field with View of Arles
items.description_narrative: Two harvesters bend to their work in a vast, golden wheat field, a bound sheaf standing in the foreground like a small monument. Beyond the field, the rooftops and spires of a town rise pale blue-green under a swirling yellow sky. Van Gogh painted this harvest scene at Arles in June 1888; it belongs to the Musée Rodin.
items.tags: wheat field, harvest, arles, figures, golden light, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Les Alyscamps
items.description_narrative: A tree-lined avenue in blazing autumn gold stretches toward a distant tower, two figures strolling beneath the branches. Van Gogh painted this avenue in 1888.
items.tags: avenue, autumn, alyscamps, arles, van gogh

items.title: At Eternity's Gate (Sorrowing Old Man)
items.description_narrative: An old man sits hunched in a wooden chair, his face buried in his clenched hands, elbows resting on his knees. Bold outlines in blue separate his worn work clothes from the pale walls and floorboards around him.
items.tags: sorrow, expressive outline, elderly figure, seated pose

items.title: A Weaver's Cottage
items.description_narrative: A weaver bends over his loom in a dim, timber-framed cottage, the only true daylight spilling through a small paned window behind him. The scene is rendered almost entirely in browns and ochres, with the loom's warp threads catching what light there is. Van Gogh painted this interior in 1884; it belongs to Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen.
items.tags: weaver, loom, cottage interior, dark palette, genre scene, window light, oil painting
items.credit_line: QQFPfLmlSNyRHQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Windmills on Montmartre
items.description_narrative: Two windmills rise above a walled garden on a hilltop, their sails catching a pale, cloud-streaked sky. In the foreground, a low picket fence and a bed of red and pink flowers border a dirt path, with a lone figure bending among the plants. Van Gogh painted these windmills on Montmartre in 1886; it belongs to the Artizon Museum.
items.tags: windmills, montmartre, garden, flowers, hilltop, landscape, oil painting
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – Image

items.title: Daubigny's Garden
items.description_narrative: A garden path curves past flowerbeds and a black cat crouched in the grass, a house and church tower visible beyond a garden wall. Van Gogh painted this in July 1890.
items.tags: garden, flowerbeds, black cat, auvers-sur-oise, van gogh

items.title: Sunset at Montmajour
items.description_narrative: Twisted trees lean across a scrubby hillside beneath a churning, luminous sky of green, gold, and gray at dusk. A hazy fortress silhouette shows at left, small and distant beneath the dominant sweep of clouds.
items.tags: landscape, sunset, hillside, trees, oil painting

items.title: Fishing Boats on the Beach at Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer
items.description_narrative: Colorful fishing boats sit beached on the sand at Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer, their masts angled against a pale sky, while sailboats cross the water beyond. Van Gogh painted this version in oil in 1888, based on an earlier study of the same boats, and it now hangs in the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: fishing boats, beach, seascape, sailboats, van gogh, provence, marine
items.credit_line: Van Gogh Museum s0028V1962; Wikidata Q2884896 (Google Art Project)

items.title: Blossoming Chestnut Branches
items.description_narrative: White and pink chestnut blossoms cluster along a leafy branch, outlined in dark contour lines against a swirling blue background. Van Gogh painted this in 1890; the work is held in the Foundation E.G. Bührle Collection.
items.tags: chestnut blossoms, still life, branch, blue background, van gogh, 1890

items.title: The Church at Auvers
items.description_narrative: A stone church with a tall steeple rises against a swirling, deep blue sky, its walls rendered in thick, twisting strokes of yellow-green, a lone woman walking the path below. Van Gogh painted this in June 1890; it belongs to the Musée d'Orsay.
items.tags: church, auvers-sur-oise, blue sky, van gogh, musée d'orsay, night palette
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture: Home page – Image

items.title: Acacia in Flower
items.description_narrative: Clusters of pale acacia blossoms crowd a tangle of branches, seen close up from below against patches of blue sky. Thick, restless brushstrokes in yellow-green and white capture the density of the flowering canopy.
items.tags: acacia blossoms, close-up, thick brushwork, botanical study

items.title: Sunflowers (Van Gogh Museum version)
items.description_narrative: A vase of sunflowers in full bloom and past their peak fills the canvas against a warm yellow wall, a red line marking the table's edge below. The signature on the vase is worked directly into the wet paint of the pot itself.
items.tags: sunflowers, vase, yellow palette, still life, oil painting

items.title: A Pair of Leather Clogs
items.description_narrative: A pair of worn leather clogs sit askew on a bare wooden floor, painted in loose, textured strokes of green and ochre. Vincent van Gogh painted this still life in 1889; it belongs to the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: van gogh, still life, clogs, shoes, post-impressionism, oil painting, dutch

items.title: The Brothel (Le Lupanar)
items.description_narrative: Women in bright yellow and pink dresses gather around small tables in a dim, green-walled room, a couple embracing at the far right. Van Gogh painted this interior in October 1888; it belongs to the Barnes Foundation.
items.tags: interior scene, figures, brothel, arles, van gogh, barnes foundation

items.title: Still Life with Basket of Apples (dedicated to Lucien Pissarro)
items.description_narrative: A shallow woven basket overflows with apples in gold, green, and red, tipped slightly toward the viewer on a plain cloth. Van Gogh signed the work directly onto the canvas at lower left, dedicating it to a friend.
items.tags: still life, apples, basket, oil painting

items.title: View of Saintes-Maries
items.description_narrative: Rows of lavender fields lead toward a hilltop village crowned by a fortified church tower, painted in short, directional strokes under a hazy green sky. Van Gogh painted this view of Les Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer in 1888, now in the Kröller-Müller Museum.
items.tags: landscape, village, church, lavender fields, van gogh, provence

items.title: A Meadow in the Mountains: Le Mas de Saint-Paul
items.description_narrative: Jagged gray peaks rise beneath a sky painted a startling acid yellow, while a farmhouse sits half-hidden among wind-bent trees below. Short, choppy brushstrokes turn the meadow grass into a rippling green current.
items.tags: landscape, mountains, farmhouse, meadow, yellow sky, oil painting, post-impressionism

items.title: Avenue of Poplars in Autumn
items.description_narrative: A woman in dark clothing walks alone beneath a row of tall, golden-leafed poplars lining a straight avenue. Fallen leaves carpet the path in orange and brown, the trees' thin trunks receding sharply toward a glowing horizon.
items.tags: poplar avenue, autumn, lone figure, golden leaves

items.title: Street in Saintes-Maries
items.description_narrative: Thatched cottages with steep blue-tiled roofs line a sandy street, flowering shrubs crowding the path beside them under a pale greenish sky. Van Gogh painted this street scene in Arles in June 1888.
items.tags: street scene, thatched roofs, village, provence, van gogh, landscape

items.title: Orchard with Blossoming Apricot Trees
items.description_narrative: A single apricot tree stands full of white and pink blossom, its dark, twisting branches drawn in heavy outline against a pale sky. Rows of smaller trees recede behind it through a kitchen garden thick with young plants.
items.tags: orchard, blossoms, spring, trees, landscape, oil painting

items.title: Bowl with Peonies and Roses
items.description_narrative: Pale pink peonies and roses crowd a green vase, a few loose blooms scattered on the table beside it. Van Gogh painted this bouquet in 1886; the Kröller-Müller Museum now holds it.
items.tags: still life, peonies, roses, green vase, van gogh, kröller-müller museum

items.title: Wheat Field with Cypresses (drawing)
items.medium: Black chalk and pen and ink on paper
items.description_narrative: Swirling pen lines and hatched chalk render a wheat field bending in the wind beside a flame-like row of cypress trees. Van Gogh drew this at Saint-Remy in June 1889; it belongs to the Van Gogh Museum.
items.tags: drawing, pen and ink, wheat field, cypress trees, van gogh, landscape, saint-remy

items.title: At the Salon in the Rue des Moulins
items.description_narrative: Several women in loose dresses lounge together on a pink upholstered couch inside a parlor, one in pale blue watching another dressed in white being tended to nearby. Green columns and warm ochre walls give the crowded interior a hazy, artificial glow.
items.tags: parlor interior, lounging figures, pastel palette, parisian nightlife

items.title: Horse Behind a Stable Gate
items.description_narrative: A grey horse leans its head over a wooden stable rail, its mane rendered in loose curling strokes against dark shadow. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1880.
items.tags: horse, stable, toulouse-lautrec, animal study, early work

items.title: Count Alphonse de Toulouse-Lautrec as a Falconer
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a fur hat holds a large white falcon aloft while seated on a brown horse, painted in loose, thick strokes of color. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1882; it belongs to the Musée Toulouse-Lautrec.
items.tags: equestrian portrait, falconry, horse, toulouse-lautrec, musée toulouse-lautrec

items.title: At the Moulin Rouge: Beginning of the Quadrille
items.description_narrative: A dancer in a flowing tan dress kicks up her leg mid-step on a crowded dance floor, while a woman in a lavish feathered hat and fur collar strolls past in the foreground. Men in top hats cluster around the edges, watching the performance beneath strings of hanging lights.
items.tags: moulin rouge, cabaret dance, top hats, cancan, nightlife
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D. C., online collection

items.title: Alfred La Guigne
items.description_narrative: A man in a bowler hat turns his head as a woman in a fur-trimmed collar leans close beside him, her painted lips forming a sly smile. Loosely brushed figures and a warning-sign silhouette fill the background of this loosely brushed scene.
items.tags: post-impressionism, cabaret scene, loose sketch, paris nightlife
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington, D. C., online collection

items.title: A Passing Conquest
items.description_narrative: A woman in a white petticoat and black corset stands with her back to us, caught mid-dress, while a man in a top hat watches from a chair behind her. Lautrec leaves much of the paper bare, sketching the scene in quick, confident lines rather than filling it in.
items.tags: dressing room, corset, figures, interior, sketch

items.title: Young Horseman Mounting His Horse
items.description_narrative: A young rider in a dark cap and pale jacket leans low over a chestnut horse's neck, one hand gripping the reins as the horse's head drops toward the ground. The scene is loosely brushed, the background dissolving into soft greens and browns. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this equestrian study in 1880.
items.tags: equestrian, horse, young rider, oil sketch, loose brushwork, animal painting

items.title: Portrait of François Gauzi
items.description_narrative: A man in a long green coat and top hat stands in profile in a doorway, hands in his pockets, looking off to one side. The bare wood floor and pale window at left give the scene the feel of a quiet, empty studio.
items.tags: portrait, man, top hat, doorway, oil painting

items.title: In Bed
items.description_narrative: This painting by Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec is catalogued at Albi as dating from 1894. It shows two reclining figures sharing a bed, rendered in loose, sketch-like outlines and muted washes, with an empty chair beside them.
items.tags: toulouse-lautrec, in bed, oil sketch, albi, post-impressionism, bedroom scene

items.title: Carmen the Redhead (Carmen la Rousse)
items.description_narrative: A young woman with reddish hair looks slightly away, her collar and cuffs painted in soft white against a dim brown ground. This portrait is dated 1885 and attributed to Toulouse-Lautrec.
items.tags: portrait, young woman, redhead, toulouse-lautrec, early work

items.title: Avenue at Céleyran
items.description_narrative: A yellow farmhouse glows through a dense screen of trees and shrubs at the end of a quiet garden path. Loose, sketchy brushwork in green and gold fills the foreground foliage.
items.tags: avenue, garden path, farmhouse, loose brushwork

items.title: The Master of the Hunt
items.description_narrative: A rider in a red hunting coat urges his horse forward at a gallop, whip raised overhead. The loose, quick brushwork and visible canvas texture suggest a rapid sketch rather than a finished study, capturing motion more than detail.
items.tags: horse, rider, hunting scene, red coat, sketch, oil painting, motion

items.title: The White Horse Gazelle
items.description_narrative: A pale grey horse's head fills most of the canvas, ears pricked and eye alert, painted with loose, confident strokes against a bare beige ground. Warm brown shading models the muzzle and neck, and the background is left largely unfinished. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this horse portrait in 1881; it belongs to the Musée Toulouse-Lautrec.
items.tags: horse portrait, animal painting, sketch, unfinished background, oil painting, equine study

items.title: Artilleryman Saddling His Horse
items.description_narrative: A soldier in a dark uniform adjusts the saddle on a pale grey horse beneath a hazy stand of trees. A second rider is faintly visible in the misty background, the whole scene rendered in soft, blurred strokes.
items.tags: military scene, horse, soft brushwork, misty landscape

items.title: Horse in the Stable at Céleyran
items.description_narrative: A horse stands in its stall against warm orange walls, its coat built from thick strokes of grey, brown, and white. This sketch by Toulouse-Lautrec is dated 1882, showing the stables at Céleyran.
items.tags: horse, stable, céleyran, toulouse-lautrec, animal study

items.title: Study of a Woman, Nude from Behind
items.description_narrative: A woman is seen from behind, her back and raised arm defined by fluid outlines with touches of white highlighting her shoulder and hip against a warm ochre ground. Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec created this nude study in 1896.
items.tags: nude study, toulouse-lautrec, figure, back view, post-impressionism, oil painting, french, portraiture study

items.title: At Her Toilette
items.description_narrative: A woman in a pale green robe leans over a dressing table cluttered with small jars and bottles, trimming her nails with quiet concentration. Her long auburn hair falls loosely around her face, set against a richly patterned wallpaper.
items.tags: toilette scene, dressing table, patterned wallpaper, intimate interior

items.title: Portrait of Émile Bernard
items.description_narrative: A young man with tousled brown hair and a faint mustache gazes forward against a mottled teal-green background, wearing a dark jacket, white collar, and necktie pinned with a small red button. Painted by Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec in 1885–86, this portrait of Émile Bernard is held by Tate on loan to the National Gallery, London.
items.tags: portrait, toulouse-lautrec, emile bernard, post-impressionism, oil painting, tate, national gallery
items.credit_line: Frey, Julia: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, BB art, Praha 1999
items.current_repository: Tate (on loan to the National Gallery, London)

items.title: At the Moulin Rouge: Portrait of Monsieur Warner
items.description_narrative: A bearded man's face emerges from loose, sketchy brushwork, his hair swept back in a dark curling line. Pale blue-green touches shade his collar, the quick, economical strokes leaving much of the ground bare.
items.tags: head study, quick sketch, cabaret patron

items.title: At the Moulin Rouge: The Dance
items.description_narrative: A woman in a red-trimmed cream dress dances the can-can, her leg kicked high as a partner in black looks on. A crowd in dark suits and top hats fills the dance hall behind them, its floor rendered in loose sweeps of green and gold.
items.tags: moulin rouge, cancan, dance hall, top hats, nightlife
items.credit_line: FAENd9LSU-ylzQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Portrait of Caudieux
items.description_narrative: Sketched in quick lines on tan paper, a man in profile lifts a hand toward his chin, a touch of green at his collar the only real color in the drawing. The loose, unfinished quality leaves much of the sheet bare.
items.tags: sketch, profile, drawing, quick study

items.title: Crouching Woman (The Laundress)
items.description_narrative: In a few rapid strokes of blue chalk and white on brown paper, a woman crouches low, her wide skirt spread around her and one arm reaching toward the ground. This sketch of a laundress is dated 1893 and held by the Musée Toulouse-Lautrec.
items.tags: sketch, laundress, chalk drawing, crouching figure, musée toulouse-lautrec

items.title: La Grande Loge (The Large Theatre Box)
items.description_narrative: A couple sit close together in a red theater box, the man in a top hat and the woman in an elaborate feathered hat, with empty chairs behind them. Toulouse-Lautrec made this color lithograph, known as La Grande Loge, around 1896-97.
items.tags: lithograph, theater box, couple, toulouse-lautrec, parisian nightlife, top hat

items.title: At the Racecourse
items.description_narrative: Two figures in dark coats lean against a fence rail beside an open green field, watching riders gathered in the distant haze. A cluster of low buildings and trees glows warmly under an orange-tinted sky.
items.tags: racecourse, hazy landscape, fence, distant riders, warm sky

items.title: Horse Behind a Picket Gate
items.description_narrative: A horse's head and mane emerge from behind pale fence rails in thick, streaked strokes of blue, white, and orange, applied almost like a close-up study. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1882.
items.tags: horse, fence, close study, toulouse-lautrec, impasto

items.title: The Clowness Cha-U-Kao
items.description_narrative: Seen from behind, a performer in a voluminous yellow ruffled costume sits at a table, her powdered hair piled high. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1895.
items.tags: clown, cabaret performer, yellow costume, toulouse-lautrec, moulin rouge
items.credit_line: tAEZCE0HugJzAQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Allegory: The Springtime of Life
items.description_narrative: A satyr-like figure strides off carrying a nude woman across his back, passing close by a reclining lion while a small child crouches near its head. In the distance, a line of children dance together across an open field.
items.tags: allegory, mythological scene, lion, dancing children, sepia tones

items.title: Horseman in Eighteenth-Century Costume
items.description_narrative: A rider in a wide-brimmed hat and red coat sits astride a dark horse, rendered in soft, hazy strokes against an open landscape. This 1880 sketch is by Toulouse-Lautrec.
items.tags: equestrian portrait, historical costume, toulouse-lautrec, early work

items.title: The Sofa (Le Divan)
items.description_narrative: A heavyset woman in a bright orange robe sits at the center of a red sofa, flanked by other women in pink and green. Lautrec picks her out with the boldest color in the room, letting the figures beside her fade into looser, quieter brushwork.
items.tags: sofa, brothel interior, figures, bold color, oil painting

items.title: Jane Avril Dancing
items.description_narrative: A dancer in a white ruffled skirt kicks one leg high, her hair topped with a dark feathered hat, sketched loosely over tan paper. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this around 1892.
items.tags: dancer, cabaret, kick pose, toulouse-lautrec, moulin rouge
items.credit_line: awEEswUy3gXkdg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: At the Cabaret
items.description_narrative: A seated man in a bold orange coat leans toward a companion wreathed in pale pipe smoke, rendered in loose colored lines with the ground left largely bare. Streaks of green and red suggest clothing and gesture rather than precise detail.
items.tags: cabaret sketch, loose lines, pipe smoke, gestural study

items.title: English Soldier Smoking a Pipe
items.description_narrative: In loose orange and blue pencil strokes on tan paper, a soldier in a peaked cap tilts his head back, pipe raised to his lips. This sketch, by Toulouse-Lautrec, is dated 1898.
items.tags: sketch, soldier, pipe, colored pencil, toulouse-lautrec

items.title: View of the Vineyards at Céleyran
items.description_narrative: A pale, overcast sky presses low over an open field, its grass rendered in loose dabs of green and ochre. Rows of dark, bushy vines fill the foreground, with a single small figure standing far off near a distant fence line. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this vineyard view at Céleyran in 1880; it belongs to the Musée Toulouse-Lautrec.
items.tags: vineyard, field, overcast sky, figure, landscape, oil sketch, rural

items.title: By the River at Céleyran
items.description_narrative: Trees lean over a still river, their reflections dissolving into loose blue and green brushwork on the water's surface. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1880; it belongs to the Musée Toulouse-Lautrec.
items.tags: landscape, river, reflections, céleyran, toulouse-lautrec, early work

items.title: Rolande on the Sofa
items.description_narrative: A woman with short reddish hair leans back against a green sofa, resting her arm across a second reclining figure whose dark hair spills over a pillow. The paint is thin and quick, leaving broad passages of bare canvas around the two figures.
items.tags: sofa, figures, interior, sketch, oil painting

items.title: Aristide Bruant on a Bicycle
items.description_narrative: A hunched figure in a wide-brimmed hat leans forward over unseen handlebars, rendered in a few quick strokes of blue, the tan ground left largely bare. The loose, economical lines capture motion and posture rather than fine detail.
items.tags: quick sketch, blue lines, cyclist, gestural study

items.title: Huntsman on Horseback
items.description_narrative: A red-capped rider on horseback leads a group down a sunlit path, a dog bounding alongside as long shadows stretch across the ground. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1879.
items.tags: hunting scene, horseback, dog, toulouse-lautrec, early work

items.title: Clown
items.description_narrative: A performer in a pale ruffled collar and conical hat gestures broadly with one arm, painted almost entirely in grey and black against a raw canvas ground. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in the 1880s.
items.tags: clown, circus, monochrome, gesture, toulouse-lautrec

items.title: Artist with Green Gloves: The Singer Dolly
items.description_narrative: A woman in a green ruffled blouse and matching glove leans forward with one hand raised, her auburn hair piled loosely atop her head. Quick, overlapping outlines capture her twisting pose and low neckline, the green rendered in loose, sketchy strokes.
items.tags: cabaret performer, green gloves, quick sketch, gestural line

items.title: The Terrace at Château du Bosc
items.description_narrative: A tree with a broad, layered crown shades a stone garden path, its branches rendered in loose dabs of gold and green against a soft sky. A stone urn or gate structure is just visible through the foliage at the path's end.
items.tags: terrace, garden, tree, oil painting

items.title: Portrait of André Rivoire
items.description_narrative: Seen in profile against a mottled green ground, a mustached man in a red cravat tilts his head with a faint, knowing smile. The brushwork on the background is broad and dry, leaving the canvas weave visible in places.
items.tags: portrait, man, profile, oil painting

items.title: The Nun's Pines at Céleyran
items.description_narrative: Tall pines rise against a warm, golden field beneath a hazy pink sky, rendered with the loose, quick strokes of a plein-air sketch. Empty of figures, the scene reads as a quiet corner of parkland at the height of summer light.
items.tags: landscape, pine trees, rural, sketch, oil painting

items.title: The Black Countess
items.description_narrative: A woman in a black dress rides in a horse-drawn barouche along a seaside promenade, with beachgoers and palm trees in the background. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this scene in oil on cardboard in 1881, an early work now held at Harvard's Fogg Museum.
items.tags: portrait, carriage, horse, beach, toulouse-lautrec, early work, genre scene

items.title: Woman Seated in a Garden
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dark brown jacket over a white blouse sits in profile against a leafy garden backdrop, a tall tree trunk rising just behind her. Her hair is swept up, and dappled light falls across the foliage behind her shoulder. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this garden portrait in 1891; it belongs to the National Gallery.
items.tags: garden portrait, woman, profile, foliage, plein air, oil painting

items.title: The Ballet of Papa Chrysanthème
items.description_narrative: A dancer leaps mid-air, her leg extended and skirts flying, captured in loose strokes of blue, white, and lavender, the ground left largely bare. A backstage railing and striped curtain are quickly indicated behind her in a few economical lines.
items.tags: ballet, dancer, quick sketch, backstage, gestural study

items.title: At the Bastille: Jeanne Wenz
items.description_narrative: A woman in a black blouse and white apron stands at a round cafe table, one hand resting on a glass. Her direct gaze and simple bow at her collar stand out against the loosely painted tavern interior behind her.
items.tags: cafe scene, white apron, direct gaze, tavern interior
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.

items.title: La Goulue and Her Sister
items.medium: Oil à l'essence on gelatin silver print mounted on board
items.description_narrative: Two women in dark, high-collared dresses stand close together on a dance floor, painted loosely over tan cardboard with visible sketch lines. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this around 1892; it's held by the National Gallery of Art.
items.tags: cabaret, dancers, toulouse-lautrec, moulin rouge, national gallery of art
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.

items.title: Portrait of Maxime Dethomas
items.description_narrative: Seated at a small café table, a heavyset man in a top hat and dark coat holds a cane, a half-full glass in front of him. Behind him, two women in pink ruffled gowns turn away, their forms softened into pale color against the dim interior.
items.tags: portrait, cafe, top hat, nightlife, oil painting
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.

items.title: The Artist's Dog, Flèche
items.description_narrative: A white-and-tan dog with long floppy ears sits attentively beneath a gnarled tree trunk, watching a small bird pecking nearby on the ground. Warm, loose brushwork fills the shaded garden setting around it.
items.tags: dog portrait, garden setting, warm palette, animal study
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.

items.title: Horsewoman (Amazone)
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dark riding habit and top hat gallops sidesaddle on a rearing horse, a dog and a second rider visible in the hazy distance. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1881.
items.tags: horsewoman, equestrian, riding habit, toulouse-lautrec, early work

items.title: The Jockeys
items.description_narrative: A jockey in bright red silks rides past on a dark horse, a dog trotting at its heels, the ground streaked with long golden light. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this in 1882; it's held by the Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum.
items.tags: jockey, horse racing, toulouse-lautrec, thyssen-bornemisza museum

items.title: In Bed: The Kiss
items.description_narrative: Two women embrace in bed, foreheads and lips touching, rendered in soft strokes of blue-green and warm skin tones. Toulouse-Lautrec painted this around 1892.
items.tags: intimate scene, kiss, bed, toulouse-lautrec, figure painting

items.title: The Bedroom
items.description_narrative: A simple bedroom glows in saturated yellow and blue - a wooden bed with a red coverlet, a small table, two chairs, and a window are all the room holds. Van Gogh painted this 1889 version, now at the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: bedroom interior, van gogh, yellow and blue, simple furniture, 1889, art institute of chicago
items.credit_line: rgHdFPzCeCfnxQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
